Ray Grieselhuber · April 12, 2026

Introducing the AI Frontier Model Tracker

# The Age of Frontier Intelligence
### Leading Frontier Models in 2026
#### Copilot and Copilot Studio
Microsoft’s approach effectively bridges open and closed models and makes frontier AI accessible: Foundry gives direct access to both the best closed models (like GPT-4/GPT-5 series) and strong open models, and Copilot Studio provides the means to quickly build applications on top of those models
